text:
Elena Park: Offering Rajesh Kumar (Senior Backend) — base 185k, signing 12k, relocation 6k. Proposed start 2026-08-03. Manager requests PTO split for first month (2 days preloaded) and gross-up on relocation 6k due to local tax exposure. Need routing.

Ravi Sinha: @Elena please confirm whether relocation gross-up is one-time and taxable (usually yes). We'll need comp approval for any gross-up beyond standard policy.

Elena Park: Yes one-time, taxable. Manager included brief justification in ATS: relocation to higher-tax jurisdiction and candidate asks for net-neutral.

Marta Gomez: Benefits-Team: For 08-03 start some carriers treat month start as 08-01 enrollment, others on first of next month. If carrier delays, we can offer a one-time $200 health bridge.

Payroll-bot: Payroll needs GL code and payroll event code. Example line item we will accept in the spreadsheet: 

RECORD, Rajesh Kumar, START=2026-08-03, GROSSUP=6000, GL=RELO_GUP_2026, EVENT=SIGN_GUP

Ravi Sinha: From comp side, this looks like an exception to our standard relocation policy. Route: comp approver -> finance director -> payroll. If you want to avoid moving start date, consider PTO frontload instead of shifting month.

Elena Park: Candidate prefers not to change start date. Manager agrees to frontload 2 PTO days for August and keep start 08-03. Will attach comp justification and manager note.

Payroll-bot: Frontload PTO is doable as a manual PTO credit on first payroll. Need People Ops Lead approval.

Marta Gomez: We'll draft offer language with optional $200 bridge and confirm carrier specifics.

Recruiter-bot: Offer draft created: offer-8459 (status: draft). Link: https://recruiter.internal/offers/8459

Ravi Sinha: Action list: Elena to upload justification and mark comp exception; Ravi will route to Finance Director for gross-up sign-off; Payroll will await GL code; Benefits will finalize bridge text for offer.

Elena Park: Uploaded docs and pinged manager. Candidate verbally accepts frontload + bridge and prefers 08-03. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
